tasks.title: UXRCE_DDS_AG_IP from an address
tasks.statement: The Micro XRCE-DDS agent on the Jetson listens at **192.168.{c}.{d}**. What value goes into `UXRCE_DDS_AG_IP` (IPv4 as a signed int32)?
tasks.solution: u = 192·2²⁴ + 168·2¹⁶ + c·2⁸ + d. The top bit is set (192 ≥ 128), so the signed value = u − 2³². Check against the parameter description: 192.168.1.2 → −1062731518.

tasks.title: MAVLink bandwidth with MAV_1_RATE = 0
tasks.statement: `MAV_1_RATE = 0`, `SER_TEL2_BAUD = {b}`. What bandwidth does the MAVLink instance take by itself, in bytes/s?
tasks.solution: Per the parameter description (mavlink module.yaml): 0 is half the theoretical bandwidth, baud/20 bytes/s (baud/10 is the maximum for 8N1).

tasks.title: Battery-side current of the Jetson
tasks.statement: The Jetson in the **{p} W** mode plus 5 W for the carrier board and camera, a DC-DC with efficiency 0.9, a **{n}S** battery at the lower limit of 3.3 V per cell. What current does the converter draw from the battery, in A?
tasks.solution: I = (P + 5)/(η·U_min), U_min = 3.3·n. The module example: 25 W on 4S → 30/(0.9·13.2) = 2.53 A. Size the converter for 1.5 × (P + 5) W (a course guideline).
